decision_rules: Use an existing proven Plenum function before any SaaS alternative.
Install source-only skills only after verified license/provenance; load only per role and task.
Free plan or open source does not guarantee free hosting, APIs, token inference or unlimited usage.
No account signup, external communication, ads, payment or proprietary data transfer from this PUBLIC registry.
An agent's metadata sources or CI pass is not a transcript, account login, completed deployment or verified customer deliverable.
Use official API/connector where authorized; browser only for non-API tasks; private records cannot go in public GitHub.
